_about: URLs that gave usable prices on earlier runs. The routine tries these first and keeps this file up to date.

blocked.Essent: website + tariff window refuse automated browsers; fixed-contract sheets reachable as PDF (see document_patterns); variable fixed charge: owner enters it in manual.csv
blocked.Energiedirect: same platform as Essent: tariffs only in the website's tariff window after a postcode; owner enters the fixed charge in manual.csv
blocked.Vattenfall: prices only behind a postcode form; tariff sheet URLs 404 (checked 2026-10-04..06); owner enters it via Help wanted
blocked.Vandebron: no public tariff sheet: the modelcontract page mentions a tarievenblad but links none (checked 2026-10-06); owner enters it via Help wanted
blocked.United Consumers: no public variable tariff: modelcontract page 404, comparison sites give only ranges (checked 2026-10-06); owner enters it via Help wanted

Essent.note: Official consumer reference tariffs (fixed contracts), reachable with curl. The variable tariffs and the fixed supply charge are only shown in the website's tariff window after a postcode, which blocks automated access. Find the current month's sheet via WebSearch 'tb-ref-zhg essent <maand> 2026'.

not_usable.samenom.nl Tarieven-Modelcontract-Vast-e: comes up in searches for Vandebron but is SamenOM's own tariff sheet
